exposure: observed and unobserved maternal health factors
maternal, fetal, and placental risk factors
proportion of African Americans among all women delivering in a hospital
cohort: The study included 493,433 women who delivered infants and were discharged from 255 Californian hospitals in 2010.
finding: Cesarean rates were significantly higher overall for African American women compared to other women, and these elevated risks persisted after adjusting for various risk factors.
mod_finding: African American women experienced significantly higher overall, elective, and emergency primary cesarean rates compared to other women, with elevated risks (odds ratio generally > 1.27) persisting after risk adjustment.
